query: United States automobile import tariffs current rates effective dates

statements.text: Proclamation and fact sheet issued imposing 25% tariff on automobiles and certain automobile parts, effective for automobiles on April 3, 2025, and no later than May 3, 2025, for auto parts. Special tariff exemptions for USMCA-compliant auto parts and for the value of US content embedded in autos imported under USMCA.
Automobiles took effect April 3, 2025; automobile parts took effect May 3, 2025.
Federal Register Notice issued reducing the 25% tariffs on certain Taiwanese auto parts, aerospace components, and wood products to 15%, effective retroactively to May 1, 2026.

Proclamation and fact sheet issued imposing a 25% tariff on imports from all countries of medium- and heavy-duty vehicles (Classes 3 & 8) and parts, and a 10% tariff on buses, effective November 1, 2025.
Proclamation 10984 imposes a 25% tariff on Class III–VIII trucks and their parts and a 10% tariff on buses, effective November 1, 2025 (separate from the passenger-vehicle tariff).
